correctness.rationale: An exact accepted-language identity for both power and nonpower shifts is followed by a complete reachable Myhill-Nerode residual classification. Nonpower quotients comprise root, dead, r+1 distinct infinite residuals, h distinct two-element residuals, s distinct singleton suffixes. Power shifts have root, dead, one infinite and s-1 singleton residuals. All classes are distinguished by infinite/finite cardinality, distinct length or exceptional suffix, proving exact bounds. Sharp dyadic extremizers follow analytically. Separately constructed NFAs determinized and minimized agree for shifts 1..4095; arithmetic output checks pass for 100 shifts times 180 indices with padding. Computation is corroboration, not infinity proof.

value.rationale: A recent primary theorem focuses on the same natural sparse automatic sequence but proves only logarithmic complexity; determining the precise minimum is a mathematically motivated unresolved refinement. The new formula reveals an exact bit-pattern/right-quotient mechanism and sharp dyadic envelopes attained by explicit shifts, replacing a qualitative logarithmic claim with a uniform exact classification rather than an arbitrary finite enumeration.
